This is economically grounded (mean reversion works best in range-bound/up-trending markets) and uses a single additional parameter, minimizing overfitting risk. Vol scaling to 12% with 1.5x cap preserves the favourable risk profile observed in prior iterations.

The best prior result (iter_4, Sharpe 1.07) came from requiring BOTH a short-term mean-reversion long signal AND a longer-term momentum uptrend (mode='all'), which filters reversion entries to only those aligned with the prevailing trend.
